name: svraster
description: [CVPR 2025] Sparse Voxels Rasterization: Real-time High-fidelity Radiance Field Rendering

paragraphs: Paper abstract We propose an efficient radiance field rendering algorithm that incorporates a rasterization process on adaptive sparse voxels without neural networks or 3D Gaussians. There are two key contributions coupled with the proposed system. The first is to adaptively and explicitly allocate sparse voxels to different levels of detail within scenes, faithfully reproducing scene details with 65536^3 grid resolution while achieving high rendering frame rates. Second, we customize a rasterizer for efficient adaptive sparse voxels rendering. We render voxels in the correct depth order by…
features: Jun 6, 2025: Major code refactoring. Add document to create model from voxels or points in a differentiable way.
Mar 18, 2025: Revise literature review. Support depthanythingv2 relative depth loss and mast3r metric depth loss for a better geometry.

Mar 8, 2025: Support ScanNet++ dataset. Check the benchmark for our results on the 3rd-party hidden set evaluation. Our short article may be helpful if you want to work on scannet or indoor environement.
